summary: Three prior implementation findings are resolved. Remaining defects concern snapshot session isolation and stale event reconciliation, boundary enforcement of package direction/public APIs, raw unredacted invalid tool fallback, and one omitted test in the declared test target.

open_findings.trigger: Valid snapshot contains a message from another session or run.
open_findings.impact: All baseline messages are accepted; appended-event filtering alone does not isolate session data and also drops prior runs in the same session.
open_findings.correction: Carry session identity in messages/events; filter snapshots and events by session, retaining earlier runs in that session. Add mixed-session regression coverage.

open_findings.trigger: Completed snapshot plus older running event.
open_findings.impact: Projection rolls run status backward in both the page and assistant-ui runtime.
open_findings.correction: Bind snapshot state to event cursor/revision and only apply newer events; test stale ordering both ways.

open_findings.trigger: Shared package imports renderer source or app deep-imports private @workbench/ui path.
open_findings.impact: Checker allows reverse package dependency and deep private imports contrary to public API direction.
open_findings.correction: Enforce importer-specific allowed project edges and public entries; constrain aliases and add negative fixtures.

open_findings.trigger: Invalid tool result contains secret-like values under size limit.
open_findings.impact: Raw serialized values are displayed without masking.
open_findings.correction: Render a bounded redacted summary or omit raw fields; add synthetic secret-canary test.

open_findings.impact: A fixture transport test is omitted from the actual recorded target.
open_findings.correction: Use recursive test discovery or include the omitted test file.

verification_limits: Recorded frozen install, format, lint, typecheck, tests, build, and boundary checks pass. Reviewer did not execute tests. Browser-mounted renderer E2E and actual SDK/control-channel security remain unverified; all synthetic mutations stay denied.
